gaps.quote: The paper obtains a strict power saving in the logarithmic factor in that model. (cited)
gaps.note: The page does not say what bound the paper obtains (its form, or any exponent or constant), so the reader cannot see what 'power saving' means here. The page also does not say why a saving in the logarithmic factor contradicts the conjecture. That needs the new bound to be o(n log n), which the page never states or derives. The cited claim is the only support for the page's conclusion that the conjecture fails, and its content and role are not given.
